name: Sensefold
author: SenseFold Labs
description: Personal context for every AI: search, read, and write back to your private Markdown library of articles, threads, PDFs, notes, and captured ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Grok conversations. Remote server, OAuth 2.1 or revocable tiered Agent keys. Every agent edit is versioned and revertible.

tools.name: search_hub
tools.description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search across the whole library; English, Chinese, or mixed queries. Filters: tags, provenance, date range.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Recent items, newest first, with optional date range, provenance, and literal keyword filters.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Read one saved item by UUID as Markdown text, in windows or by matched section.

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: The user's plan, remaining AI credits, limits, and reset time.

tools.name: save_link
tools.description: Save an HTTP(S) URL; capture and enrichment run asynchronously. Idempotent by client-supplied UUID. Requires the edit tier.

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Save a plain-text or Markdown note, stored verbatim. Idempotent by client-supplied UUID. Requires the edit tier.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Replace an item's user-authored text, optionally rename it. Requires expectedVersion; revision-backed and undoable. Edit tier.

tools.name: update_tags
tools.description: Replace an item's full tag list (up to 20). Requires expectedVersion; revision-backed and undoable. Edit tier.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Move an item to the recycle bin; the user can restore it. Requires expectedVersion. Full tier only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Read-only alias following the ChatGPT connector contract; maps onto search_hub.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read-only alias following the ChatGPT connector contract; maps onto get_item with metadata.next_id continuation.
